records.summary: Added Bitquery's public on-chain trace: 17 Binance PoR-labelled hot wallets across nine chains, including five XRPL source accounts; the XRPL receiver shares no address with the other attack clusters and held about 233.5M XRP with no outgoing transaction through October 30 06:43 UTC. Kept cross-chain linkage at event level only. Corrected the architecture-decision artifact path: the first file was mistakenly serialized as a path string; it is preserved and superseded by a valid JSON decision object. No market features or forecasts were admitted.
